8223/// The table, `SET` columns with their values, and `WHERE` of an `UPDATE` statement,
8224/// rejecting unsupported forms. A tuple assignment `(a, b) = (x, y)` is one per column.
8225fn update_parts(update: &Update) -> PolarsResult<UpdateParts<'_>> {
8226    // Destructure exhaustively so new sqlparser fields surface as compile errors.
8227    let Update {
8228        update_token: _,
8229        optimizer_hints: _,
8230        table,
8231        assignments,
8232        from,
8233        selection,
8234        returning,
8235        output,
8236        or,
8237        order_by,
8238        limit,
8239    } = update;
8240    polars_ensure!(from.is_none(), SQLInterface: "UPDATE does not support the FROM clause");
8241    polars_ensure!(returning.is_none(), SQLInterface: "UPDATE does not support the RETURNING clause");
8242    polars_ensure!(output.is_none(), SQLInterface: "UPDATE does not support the OUTPUT clause");
8243    polars_ensure!(or.is_none(), SQLInterface: "UPDATE does not support `UPDATE OR ...`");
8244    polars_ensure!(order_by.is_empty(), SQLInterface: "UPDATE does not support the ORDER BY clause");
8245    polars_ensure!(limit.is_none(), SQLInterface: "UPDATE does not support the LIMIT clause");
8246    polars_ensure!(table.joins.is_empty(), SQLInterface: "UPDATE does not support table JOINs");
8247    check_dml_target(&table.relation, "UPDATE")?;
8248    let mut parts: Vec<(String, SQLExpr)> = Vec::with_capacity(assignments.len());
8249    for Assignment { target, value } in assignments {
8250        let pairs: Vec<(&ObjectName, SQLExpr)> = match target {
8251            AssignmentTarget::ColumnName(name) => vec![(name, value.clone())],
8252            AssignmentTarget::Tuple(names) => {
8253                let values = tuple_values(value).ok_or_else(|| {
8254                    polars_err!(
8255                        SQLInterface: "UPDATE assigns a tuple of columns from a list of values, as `(a, b) = (1, 2)`; got `{}`", value
8256                    )
8257                })?;
8258                polars_ensure!(
8259                    values.len() == names.len(),
8260                    SQLInterface: "UPDATE assigns {} columns from {} values (`{} = {}`)",
8261                    names.len(), values.len(), target, value
8262                );
8263                names.iter().zip(values).collect()
8264            },
8265        };
8266        for (name, value) in pairs {
8267            let [ObjectNamePart::Identifier(ident)] = name.0.as_slice() else {
8268                polars_bail!(
8269                    SQLInterface: "UPDATE takes unqualified column names in SET; table qualifiers and nested fields are not supported (`{}`)", name
8270                )
8271            };
8272            let column = &ident.value;
8273            polars_ensure!(
8274                !parts.iter().any(|(c, _)| c == column),
8275                SQLInterface: "multiple assignments to column '{}' in UPDATE", column
8276            );
8277            polars_ensure!(
8278                !contains_default_keyword(&value),
8279                SQLInterface: "UPDATE does not support DEFAULT (column '{}'); write NULL", column
8280            );
8281            polars_ensure!(
8282                !expr_contains_subquery(&value),
8283                SQLInterface: "subqueries are not supported in the SET of an UPDATE (column '{}')", column
8284            );
8285            polars_ensure!(
8286                !expr_has_window_functions(&value),
8287                SQLInterface: "window functions are not allowed in the SET of an UPDATE (column '{}')", column
8288            );
8289            polars_ensure!(
8290                !contains_column_selector(&value),
8291                SQLInterface: "column selectors are not allowed in the SET of an UPDATE (column '{}')", column
8292            );
8293            parts.push((column.clone(), value));
8294        }
8295    }
8296    Ok((table, parts, selection.as_ref()))
8297}
8298
8299/// The parts of a `MERGE`, rejecting the forms that it does not support.
8300fn merge_parts(merge: &Merge) -> PolarsResult<MergeParts<'_>> {
8301    // Destructure exhaustively so new sqlparser fields surface as compile errors.
8302    let Merge {
8303        merge_token: _,
8304        optimizer_hints,
8305        into,
8306        table,
8307        source,
8308        on,
8309        clauses,
8310        output,
8311    } = merge;
8312    polars_ensure!(*into, SQLInterface: "MERGE requires INTO; write `MERGE INTO {} USING ...`", table);
8313    polars_ensure!(optimizer_hints.is_empty(), SQLInterface: "optimizer hints are not supported in MERGE");
8314    match output {
8315        None => {},
8316        Some(OutputClause::Returning { .. }) => {
8317            polars_bail!(SQLInterface: "RETURNING is not yet supported in MERGE; omit RETURNING")
8318        },
8319        Some(OutputClause::Output { .. }) => {
8320            polars_bail!(SQLInterface: "OUTPUT is not supported in MERGE")
8321        },
8322    }
8323    polars_ensure!(!clauses.is_empty(), SQLInterface: "MERGE requires at least one WHEN clause");
8324    polars_ensure!(
8325        matches!(table, TableFactor::Table { .. }),
8326        SQLInterface: "MERGE requires a named catalog table as its target"
8327    );
8328    check_dml_target(table, "MERGE")?;
8329    check_merge_source(source)?;
8330    check_merge_expr(on, "ON", false)?;
8331
8332    let mut matched = Vec::new();
8333    let mut not_matched = Vec::new();
8334    // per clause kind, the unconditional clause that ends it
8335    let mut last: [Option<usize>; 2] = [None, None];
8336    for (i, clause) in clauses.iter().enumerate() {
8337        let number = i + 1;
8338        let MergeClause {
8339            when_token: _,
8340            clause_kind,
8341            predicate,
8342            action,
8343        } = clause;
8344        let (kind, name) = match clause_kind {
8345            MergeClauseKind::Matched => (0, "MATCHED"),
8346            MergeClauseKind::NotMatched | MergeClauseKind::NotMatchedByTarget => (1, "NOT MATCHED"),
8347            MergeClauseKind::NotMatchedBySource => polars_bail!(
8348                SQLInterface: "NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE is not yet supported in MERGE (WHEN clause {}); select the unmatched target keys first, then DELETE or UPDATE them in a separate statement",
8349                number
8350            ),
8351        };
8352        if let Some(first) = last[kind] {
8353            polars_bail!(
8354                SQLInterface: "WHEN clause {} of the MERGE is unreachable after the unconditional WHEN {} clause {}",
8355                number, name, first
8356            );
8357        }
8358        if predicate.is_none() {
8359            last[kind] = Some(number);
8360        }
8361        if let Some(predicate) = predicate {
8362            check_merge_expr(
8363                predicate,
8364                &format!("the condition of WHEN clause {number}"),
8365                false,
8366            )?;
8367        }
8368        let action = match action {
8369            MergeAction::Update(update) => {
8370                MergeActionParts::Update(merge_update_parts(update, number)?)
8371            },
8372            MergeAction::Delete { .. } => MergeActionParts::Delete,
8373            MergeAction::DoNothing { .. } => MergeActionParts::Nothing,
8374            MergeAction::Insert(insert) => merge_insert_parts(insert, number)?,
8375        };
8376        let parts = MergeClauseParts {
8377            number,
8378            predicate: predicate.clone(),
8379            action,
8380        };
8381        if kind == 0 {
8382            matched.push(parts);
8383        } else {
8384            not_matched.push(parts);
8385        }
8386    }
8387    Ok(MergeParts {
8388        target: table,
8389        source,
8390        on,
8391        matched,
8392        not_matched,
8393    })
8394}
8395
8396/// The `SET` columns and values of a `MERGE`'s `UPDATE` action.
8397fn merge_update_parts(
8398    update: &MergeUpdateExpr,
8399    number: usize,
8400) -> PolarsResult<Vec<(String, SQLExpr)>> {
8401    let MergeUpdateExpr {
8402        update_token: _,
8403        kind,
8404        update_predicate,
8405        delete_predicate,
8406    } = update;
8407    polars_ensure!(
8408        update_predicate.is_none(),
8409        SQLInterface: "`UPDATE ... WHERE` predicates are not supported in MERGE (WHEN clause {})", number
8410    );
8411    polars_ensure!(
8412        delete_predicate.is_none(),
8413        SQLInterface: "`DELETE WHERE` clauses are not supported in MERGE (WHEN clause {})", number
8414    );
8415    let assignments = match kind {
8416        MergeUpdateKind::Set(assignments) => assignments,
8417        MergeUpdateKind::Wildcard => polars_bail!(
8418            SQLInterface: "UPDATE SET * is not yet supported in MERGE (WHEN clause {}); write the assignments, as `UPDATE SET id = s.id, v = s.v`",
8419            number
8420        ),
8421    };
8422    let mut parts: Vec<(String, SQLExpr)> = Vec::with_capacity(assignments.len());
8423    for Assignment { target, value } in assignments {
8424        let pairs: Vec<(&ObjectName, SQLExpr)> = match target {
8425            AssignmentTarget::ColumnName(name) => vec![(name, value.clone())],
8426            AssignmentTarget::Tuple(names) => {
8427                let values = tuple_values(value).ok_or_else(|| {
8428                    polars_err!(
8429                        SQLInterface: "the UPDATE of WHEN clause {} assigns a tuple of columns from a list of values, as `(a, b) = (1, 2)`; got `{}`", number, value
8430                    )
8431                })?;
8432                polars_ensure!(
8433                    values.len() == names.len(),
8434                    SQLInterface: "the UPDATE of WHEN clause {} assigns {} columns from {} values (`{} = {}`)",
8435                    number, names.len(), values.len(), target, value
8436                );
8437                names.iter().zip(values).collect()
8438            },
8439        };
8440        for (name, value) in pairs {
8441            let [ObjectNamePart::Identifier(ident)] = name.0.as_slice() else {
8442                polars_bail!(
8443                    SQLInterface: "UPDATE in MERGE takes unqualified top-level column names; got `{}` in WHEN clause {}", name, number
8444                )
8445            };
8446            let column = &ident.value;
8447            polars_ensure!(
8448                !parts.iter().any(|(c, _)| c == column),
8449                SQLInterface: "multiple assignments to column '{}' in the UPDATE of WHEN clause {}", column, number
8450            );
8451            check_merge_expr(
8452                &value,
8453                &format!("the SET of column '{column}' in WHEN clause {number}"),
8454                true,
8455            )?;
8456            parts.push((column.clone(), value));
8457        }
8458    }
8459    Ok(parts)
8460}
8461
8462/// The columns and values of a `MERGE`'s `INSERT` action.
8463fn merge_insert_parts(insert: &MergeInsertExpr, number: usize) -> PolarsResult<MergeActionParts> {
8464    let MergeInsertExpr {
8465        insert_token: _,
8466        columns,
8467        kind_token: _,
8468        kind,
8469        insert_predicate,
8470    } = insert;
8471    polars_ensure!(
8472        insert_predicate.is_none(),
8473        SQLInterface: "`INSERT ... WHERE` predicates are not supported in MERGE (WHEN clause {})", number
8474    );
8475    let values = match kind {
8476        MergeInsertKind::Values(Values { rows, .. }) => {
8477            let [row] = rows.as_slice() else {
8478                polars_bail!(SQLInterface: "the INSERT of WHEN clause {} takes exactly one VALUES row", number)
8479            };
8480            row.content.clone()
8481        },
8482        MergeInsertKind::Row => polars_bail!(
8483            SQLInterface: "INSERT ROW is not yet supported in MERGE (WHEN clause {}); list the columns and values, as `INSERT (id, v) VALUES (s.id, s.v)`",
8484            number
8485        ),
8486        MergeInsertKind::Wildcard => polars_bail!(
8487            SQLInterface: "INSERT * is not yet supported in MERGE (WHEN clause {}); list the columns and values, as `INSERT (id, v) VALUES (s.id, s.v)`",
8488            number
8489        ),
8490    };
8491    let mut names: Vec<String> = Vec::with_capacity(columns.len());
8492    for name in columns {
8493        let [ObjectNamePart::Identifier(ident)] = name.0.as_slice() else {
8494            polars_bail!(
8495                SQLInterface: "INSERT in MERGE takes unqualified top-level column names; got `{}` in WHEN clause {}", name, number
8496            )
8497        };
8498        polars_ensure!(
8499            !names.contains(&ident.value),
8500            SQLInterface: "column '{}' is listed more than once in the INSERT of WHEN clause {}", ident.value, number
8501        );
8502        names.push(ident.value.clone());
8503    }
8504    polars_ensure!(
8505        names.is_empty() || names.len() == values.len(),
8506        SQLInterface: "the INSERT of WHEN clause {} lists {} columns but {} values", number, names.len(), values.len()
8507    );
8508    for value in &values {
8509        check_merge_expr(
8510            value,
8511            &format!("the INSERT values of WHEN clause {number}"),
8512            true,
8513        )?;
8514    }
8515    Ok(MergeActionParts::Insert {
8516        columns: (!names.is_empty()).then_some(names),
8517        values,
8518    })
8519}
8520
8521/// Reject the parts of an expression of a `MERGE` that it does not support at `location`.
8522/// Values may call `RANDOM()`; `ON` and the conditions, which the plan evaluates more than once,
8523/// may not.
8524fn check_merge_expr(expr: &SQLExpr, location: &str, allow_random: bool) -> PolarsResult<()> {
8525    // the plan's own columns are not the tables'
8526    let internal = visit_expressions(expr, |e| {
8527        let name = match e {
8528            SQLExpr::Identifier(ident) => Some(&ident.value),
8529            // `t.col`, not a struct field `t.col.field`
8530            SQLExpr::CompoundIdentifier(idents) if idents.len() == 2 => Some(&idents[1].value),
8531            _ => None,
8532        };
8533        match name {
8534            Some(name)
8535                if [MERGE_FILE, MERGE_POS, MERGE_SOURCE_ROW, MERGE_ACTION]
8536                    .contains(&name.as_str()) =>
8537            {
8538                ControlFlow::Break(name.clone())
8539            },
8540            _ => ControlFlow::Continue(()),
8541        }
8542    });
8543    if let ControlFlow::Break(name) = internal {
8544        polars_bail!(ColumnNotFound: "column '{}' not found in {} of a MERGE", name, location);
8545    }
8546    polars_ensure!(
8547        !expr_contains_subquery(expr),
8548        SQLInterface: "subqueries in {} are not yet supported in MERGE; where equivalent, compute the values in the USING subquery and use its columns", location
8549    );
8550    polars_ensure!(
8551        !expr_has_window_functions(expr),
8552        SQLInterface: "window functions are not allowed in {} of a MERGE", location
8553    );
8554    polars_ensure!(
8555        !contains_default_keyword(expr),
8556        SQLInterface: "DEFAULT in {} is not yet supported in MERGE; write the value, or NULL for a nullable column", location
8557    );
8558    polars_ensure!(
8559        !contains_column_selector(expr),
8560        SQLInterface: "column selectors are not supported in {} of a MERGE; write one expression per column", location
8561    );
8562    polars_ensure!(
8563        allow_random || !contains_random(expr, true),
8564        SQLInterface: "volatile functions in {} are not yet supported in MERGE; to draw one value per source row, compute it in the USING subquery and use that column", location
8565    );
8566    Ok(())
8567}
8568
8569/// Reject the `USING` forms of a `MERGE` that it does not support.
8570fn check_merge_source(source: &TableFactor) -> PolarsResult<()> {
8571    match source {
8572        TableFactor::Table {
8573            args: None,
8574            alias: Some(alias),
8575            ..
8576        } if !alias.columns.is_empty() => {
8577            polars_bail!(SQLInterface: "column alias lists on a plain source table are not yet supported in MERGE; wrap the table in a subquery, as `USING (SELECT * FROM src) AS s(a, b)`")
8578        },
8579        TableFactor::Derived {
8580            lateral,
8581            subquery,
8582            alias,
8583            ..
8584        } => {
8585            polars_ensure!(!lateral, SQLInterface: "LATERAL in USING is not yet supported in MERGE");
8586            polars_ensure!(
8587                alias.is_some(),
8588                SQLInterface: "a subquery in USING requires an alias; write `USING (...) AS s`"
8589            );
8590            // a plain table's alias column list is not applied inside a query yet
8591            let mut finder = PlainTableAliasColumns;
8592            polars_ensure!(
8593                dyn_visit::visit(subquery.as_ref(), &mut finder).is_continue(),
8594                SQLInterface: "column alias lists on plain tables are not yet supported in the USING subquery of a MERGE; wrap the table in a subquery, as `(SELECT * FROM src) AS x(a, b)`"
8595            );
8596        },
8597        _ => {},
8598    }
8599    Ok(())
8600}
8601
8602/// Finds a plain table with a column alias list.
8603struct PlainTableAliasColumns;
8604
8605impl Visitor for PlainTableAliasColumns {
8606    type Break = ();
8607
8608    fn pre_visit_table_factor(&mut self, factor: &TableFactor) -> ControlFlow<()> {
8609        match factor {
8610            TableFactor::Table {
8611                args: None,
8612                alias: Some(alias),
8613                ..
8614            } if !alias.columns.is_empty() => ControlFlow::Break(()),
8615            _ => ControlFlow::Continue(()),
8616        }
8617    }
8618}
8619
8620/// The name a `MERGE`'s source is known by in the statement: its alias, else the last part of
8621/// its table name.
8622fn merge_source_relation(source: &TableFactor) -> PolarsResult<RelationName> {
8623    let alias = match source {
8624        TableFactor::Table { alias, .. }
8625        | TableFactor::Derived { alias, .. }
8626        | TableFactor::TableFunction { alias, .. }
8627        | TableFactor::UNNEST { alias, .. } => alias.as_ref().map(|a| a.name.value.clone()),
8628        _ => polars_bail!(SQLInterface: "MERGE does not support this USING source: `{}`", source),
8629    };
8630    let name = alias.or_else(|| match source {
8631        TableFactor::Table { name, .. } => name
8632            .0
8633            .last()
8634            .and_then(|p| p.as_ident())
8635            .map(|i| i.value.clone()),
8636        _ => None,
8637    });
8638    name.map(|name| RelationName::new(vec![name]))
8639        .ok_or_else(|| polars_err!(SQLInterface: "a subquery in USING requires an alias; write `USING (...) AS s`"))
8640}
8641
8642/// The relations whose columns `expr` reads, by the names it writes.
8643fn merge_side(expr: &SQLExpr, scope: &MergeScope) -> MergeSide {
8644    let mut side = MergeSide::Neither;
8645    let _ = visit_expressions(expr, |e| {
8646        match e {
8647            SQLExpr::Identifier(ident) => {
8648                side = side.and(column_side(&ident.value, scope));
8649            },
8650            SQLExpr::CompoundIdentifier(idents) => {
8651                side = side.and(qualified_side(idents, scope));
8652            },
8653            _ => {},
8654        }
8655        ControlFlow::<()>::Continue(())
8656    });
8657    side
8658}
8659
8660/// The relation an unqualified column belongs to: `Both` if it is ambiguous or unknown.
8661fn column_side(name: &str, scope: &MergeScope) -> MergeSide {
8662    match (
8663        scope.target_schema.contains(name),
8664        scope.source_schema.contains(name),
8665    ) {
8666        (true, false) => MergeSide::Target,
8667        (false, true) => MergeSide::Source,
8668        _ => MergeSide::Both,
8669    }
8670}
8671
8672/// The relation a qualified column belongs to: `Both` if the qualifier names both. A first
8673/// part naming no relation is a struct column.
8674fn qualified_side(idents: &[Ident], scope: &MergeScope) -> MergeSide {
8675    match match_qualifier(idents, [scope.target, scope.source].into_iter()) {
8676        Some((relations, _)) if relations.len() == 1 => {
8677            if std::ptr::eq(relations[0], scope.target) {
8678                MergeSide::Target
8679            } else {
8680                MergeSide::Source
8681            }
8682        },
8683        Some(_) => MergeSide::Both,
8684        None => column_side(&idents[0].value, scope),
8685    }
8686}
8687
8688/// Reject a source named like the target: their columns could not be told apart.
8689fn check_distinct_relations(target: &RelationName, source: &RelationName) -> PolarsResult<()> {
8690    let last = |name: &RelationName| name.parts().last().map(|p| p.to_lowercase());
8691    polars_ensure!(
8692        last(target) != last(source),
8693        SQLInterface: "name '{}' is used for both the MERGE target and source; give them distinct aliases",
8694        source.key()
8695    );
8696    Ok(())
8697}
8698
8699/// The column of `expr` if it is a bare top-level column of the target.
8700fn target_column(expr: &SQLExpr, scope: &MergeScope) -> Option<String> {
8701    match expr {
8702        SQLExpr::Nested(inner) => target_column(inner, scope),
8703        SQLExpr::Identifier(ident) => {
8704            (column_side(&ident.value, scope) == MergeSide::Target).then(|| ident.value.clone())
8705        },
8706        SQLExpr::CompoundIdentifier(idents) => {
8707            let (relations, len) =
8708                match_qualifier(idents, [scope.target, scope.source].into_iter())?;
8709            let column = &idents[len..];
8710            (relations.len() == 1
8711                && std::ptr::eq(relations[0], scope.target)
8712                && column.len() == 1
8713                && scope.target_schema.contains(&column[0].value))
8714            .then(|| column[0].value.clone())
8715        },
8716        _ => None,
8717    }
8718}
8719
8720/// The conjuncts of `expr`, through `AND` and parentheses.
8721fn conjuncts(expr: &SQLExpr) -> Vec<&SQLExpr> {
8722    match expr {
8723        SQLExpr::Nested(inner) => conjuncts(inner),
8724        SQLExpr::BinaryOp {
8725            left,
8726            op: SQLBinaryOperator::And,
8727            right,
8728        } => {
8729            let mut parts = conjuncts(left);
8730            parts.extend(conjuncts(right));
8731            parts
8732        },
8733        _ => vec![expr],
8734    }
8735}
8736
8737/// The keys of a `MERGE`'s `ON`: the target column and source expression of each conjunct
8738/// `target_column = source_expression`. At least one is required.
8739fn merge_keys(on: &SQLExpr, scope: &MergeScope) -> PolarsResult<Vec<(String, SQLExpr)>> {
8740    let mut on_unwrapped = on;
8741    while let SQLExpr::Nested(inner) = on_unwrapped {
8742        on_unwrapped = inner;
8743    }
8744    polars_ensure!(
8745        !matches!(on_unwrapped, SQLExpr::Value(ValueWithSpan { value: SQLValue::Boolean(false), .. })),
8746        SQLInterface: "ON FALSE is not yet supported in MERGE; to insert the source rows, use `INSERT INTO ... SELECT ...`"
8747    );
8748    let mut keys = Vec::new();
8749    for conjunct in conjuncts(on) {
8750        let SQLExpr::BinaryOp {
8751            left,
8752            op: SQLBinaryOperator::Eq,
8753            right,
8754        } = conjunct
8755        else {
8756            continue;
8757        };
8758        for side in [left, right] {
8759            if let SQLExpr::Identifier(ident) = side.as_ref() {
8760                polars_ensure!(
8761                    !(scope.target_schema.contains(&ident.value)
8762                        && scope.source_schema.contains(&ident.value)),
8763                    SQLInterface: "ambiguous reference to column \"{}\" in ON of a MERGE; qualify it with the target or source name",
8764                    ident.value
8765                );
8766            }
8767        }
8768        for (target, source) in [(left, right), (right, left)] {
8769            if let Some(column) = target_column(target, scope)
8770                && merge_side(source, scope) == MergeSide::Source
8771            {
8772                keys.push((column, source.as_ref().clone()));
8773                break;
8774            }
8775        }
8776    }
8777    polars_ensure!(
8778        !keys.is_empty(),
8779        SQLInterface: "this ON condition is not yet supported in MERGE: ON must contain `target_column = source_expression`, alone or joined with AND, where the target side is a top-level target column and the source side an expression over source columns; if an equivalent condition has a common key equality, write `ON t.id = s.id AND (...)`"
8780    );
8781    Ok(keys)
8782}
8783
8784/// The source columns that a `MERGE` reads, in the source's order.
8785fn merge_source_columns(parts: &MergeParts, scope: &MergeScope) -> Vec<String> {
8786    let mut used: PlHashSet<String> = PlHashSet::new();
8787    // a name both sides have is kept, so that planning reports it as ambiguous
8788    let mut note = |expr: &SQLExpr, source_alone: bool| {
8789        let _ = visit_expressions(expr, |e| {
8790            match e {
8791                SQLExpr::Identifier(ident) => {
8792                    if scope.source_schema.contains(&ident.value) {
8793                        used.insert(ident.value.clone());
8794                    }
8795                },
8796                // WHEN NOT MATCHED sees the source alone: a first part naming no source is
8797                // a struct column
8798                SQLExpr::CompoundIdentifier(idents)
8799                    if source_alone
8800                        && match_qualifier(idents, std::iter::once(scope.source)).is_none()
8801                        && scope.source_schema.contains(&idents[0].value) =>
8802                {
8803                    used.insert(idents[0].value.clone());
8804                },
8805                SQLExpr::CompoundIdentifier(idents) => {
8806                    match match_qualifier(idents, [scope.target, scope.source].into_iter()) {
8807                        Some((relations, len)) => {
8808                            if relations.iter().any(|r| std::ptr::eq(*r, scope.source))
8809                                && let Some(column) = idents.get(len)
8810                            {
8811                                used.insert(column.value.clone());
8812                            }
8813                        },
8814                        // a struct column and its fields
8815                        None => {
8816                            if scope.source_schema.contains(&idents[0].value) {
8817                                used.insert(idents[0].value.clone());
8818                            }
8819                        },
8820                    }
8821                },
8822                _ => {},
8823            }
8824            ControlFlow::<()>::Continue(())
8825        });
8826    };
8827    note(parts.on, false);
8828    for clause in &parts.matched {
8829        if let Some(predicate) = &clause.predicate {
8830            note(predicate, false);
8831        }
8832        if let MergeActionParts::Update(assignments) = &clause.action {
8833            for (_, value) in assignments {
8834                note(value, false);
8835            }
8836        }
8837    }
8838    for clause in &parts.not_matched {
8839        if let Some(predicate) = &clause.predicate {
8840            note(predicate, true);
8841        }
8842        if let MergeActionParts::Insert { values, .. } = &clause.action {
8843            for value in values {
8844                note(value, true);
8845            }
8846        }
8847    }
8848    scope
8849        .source_schema
8850        .iter_names()
8851        .filter(|name| used.contains(name.as_str()))
8852        .map(|name| name.to_string())
8853        .collect()
8854}
8855
8856/// Whether a qualified name of a `WHEN NOT MATCHED` clause reads the source, which is all
8857/// that clause sees: the source's name or one of its struct columns.
8858fn reads_source(idents: &[Ident], scope: &MergeScope) -> bool {
8859    match_qualifier(idents, std::iter::once(scope.source)).is_some()
8860        || scope.source_schema.contains(&idents[0].value)
8861}
8862
8863/// Reject a target column in a `WHEN NOT MATCHED` clause, which sees the source alone.
8864fn check_no_target_reference(
8865    expr: &SQLExpr,
8866    scope: &MergeScope,
8867    number: usize,
8868) -> PolarsResult<()> {
8869    let mut found: Option<String> = None;
8870    let _ = visit_expressions(expr, |e| {
8871        let target = match e {
8872            SQLExpr::Identifier(ident) => (!scope.source_schema.contains(&ident.value)
8873                && scope.target_schema.contains(&ident.value))
8874            .then(|| ident.value.clone()),
8875            SQLExpr::CompoundIdentifier(idents) => (!reads_source(idents, scope)
8876                && qualified_side(idents, scope) == MergeSide::Target)
8877                .then(|| {
8878                    idents
8879                        .iter()
8880                        .map(|i| i.value.as_str())
8881                        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
8882                        .join(".")
8883                }),
8884            _ => None,
8885        };
8886        match target {
8887            Some(name) => {
8888                found = Some(name);
8889                ControlFlow::Break(())
8890            },
8891            None => ControlFlow::Continue(()),
8892        }
8893    });
8894    match found {
8895        Some(name) => polars_bail!(
8896            SQLInterface: "target column '{}' is not available in WHEN NOT MATCHED (WHEN clause {}); only source columns can be used there",
8897            name, number
8898        ),
8899        None => Ok(()),
8900    }
8901}
8902
8903/// The index of the first of `conditions` that holds, as `UInt32`; null if none does.
8904fn first_clause(conditions: Vec<Expr>) -> Expr {
8905    let mut expr = lit(LiteralValue::untyped_null()).cast(DataType::UInt32);
8906    for (k, condition) in conditions.into_iter().enumerate().rev() {
8907        expr = when(condition).then(lit(k as u32)).otherwise(expr);
8908    }
8909    expr
8910}
8911
8912/// The values of a tuple assignment: `(x, y)` or `ROW(x, y)`, or `(x)` for one column.
8913fn tuple_values(value: &SQLExpr) -> Option<Vec<SQLExpr>> {
8914    match value {
8915        SQLExpr::Tuple(values) => Some(values.clone()),
8916        SQLExpr::Nested(value) => Some(vec![value.as_ref().clone()]),
8917        SQLExpr::Function(func)
8918            if func.over.is_none()
8919                && func.filter.is_none()
8920                && matches!(func.parameters, FunctionArguments::None)
8921                && matches!(
8922                    func.name.0.as_slice(),
8923                    [ObjectNamePart::Identifier(ident)] if ident.value.eq_ignore_ascii_case("row")
8924                ) =>
8925        {
8926            let FunctionArguments::List(list) = &func.args else {
8927                return None;
8928            };
8929            if list.duplicate_treatment.is_some() || !list.clauses.is_empty() {
8930                return None;
8931            }
8932            list.args
8933                .iter()
8934                .map(|arg| match arg {
8935                    FunctionArg::Unnamed(FunctionArgExpr::Expr(e)) => Some(e.clone()),
8936                    _ => None,
8937                })
8938                .collect()
8939        },
8940        _ => None,
8941    }
8942}
8943
8944/// Whether `expr` gives each row a value from that row alone, `RANDOM()` included.
8945fn is_row_wise(expr: &Expr, schema: &Schema) -> PolarsResult<bool> {
8946    let probe = expr
8947        .clone()
8948        .map_expr(|e| if is_random(&e) { lit(0u64) } else { e });
8949    let mut arena = Arena::new();
8950    let mut ctx = ExprToIRContext::new(&mut arena, schema);
8951    let ir = to_expr_ir(&probe, &mut ctx)?;
8952    Ok(is_elementwise_rec(ir.node(), &arena))
8953}
8954
8955/// Reject the target forms of a `DELETE` or `UPDATE` that sqlparser accepts but that are not
8956/// a plain table: table-function arguments, alias column lists, and `ONLY` / `LOW_PRIORITY` /
8957/// `IGNORE`, which the generic dialect reads as a table of that name with an alias.
8958fn check_dml_target(relation: &TableFactor, statement: &str) -> PolarsResult<()> {
8959    let TableFactor::Table {
8960        name, alias, args, ..
8961    } = relation
8962    else {
8963        return Ok(());
8964    };
8965    polars_ensure!(args.is_none(), SQLInterface: "{} of a table function is not supported", statement);
8966    if let Some(alias) = alias {
8967        polars_ensure!(
8968            alias.columns.is_empty(),
8969            SQLInterface: "{} does not support column names in the table alias", statement
8970        );
8971        if let [ObjectNamePart::Identifier(ident)] = name.0.as_slice()
8972            && ident.quote_style.is_none()
8973            && ["ONLY", "LOW_PRIORITY", "IGNORE"]
8974                .iter()
8975                .any(|kw| ident.value.eq_ignore_ascii_case(kw))
8976        {
8977            polars_bail!(
8978                SQLInterface: "`{} {}` is not supported", statement, ident.value.to_uppercase()
8979            );
8980        }
8981    }
8982    Ok(())
8983}
8984
8985/// Whether `expr` uses the keyword `DEFAULT` (sqlparser reads it as an unquoted identifier).
8986fn contains_default_keyword(expr: &SQLExpr) -> bool {
8987    visit_expressions(expr, |e| match e {
8988        SQLExpr::Identifier(ident)
8989            if ident.quote_style.is_none() && ident.value.eq_ignore_ascii_case("DEFAULT") =>
8990        {
8991            ControlFlow::Break(())
8992        },
8993        _ => ControlFlow::Continue(()),
8994    })
8995    .is_break()
8996}
8997
8998/// Whether `expr` holds a wildcard or a `COLUMNS(...)` selector.
8999fn contains_column_selector(expr: &SQLExpr) -> bool {
9000    visit_expressions(expr, |e| match e {
9001        SQLExpr::Wildcard(_) | SQLExpr::QualifiedWildcard(..) => ControlFlow::Break(()),
9002        SQLExpr::Function(func)
9003            if matches!(
9004                func.name.0.as_slice(),
9005                [ObjectNamePart::Identifier(ident)] if ident.value.eq_ignore_ascii_case("columns")
9006            ) =>
9007        {
9008            ControlFlow::Break(())
9009        },
9010        _ => ControlFlow::Continue(()),
9011    })
9012    .is_break()
9013}
9014
9015/// The table name and `IF EXISTS` of a `TRUNCATE` statement, rejecting unsupported modifiers.
9016fn truncate_parts(truncate: &Truncate) -> PolarsResult<(&ObjectName, bool)> {
9017    // Destructure exhaustively so new sqlparser fields surface as compile errors.
9018    let Truncate {
9019        table_names,
9020        partitions,
9021        table: _, // whether the `TABLE` keyword was present: cosmetic
9022        if_exists,
9023        identity,
9024        cascade,
9025        on_cluster,
9026    } = truncate;
9027    polars_ensure!(identity.is_none(), SQLInterface: "`TRUNCATE ... RESTART/CONTINUE IDENTITY` is not supported");
9028    polars_ensure!(cascade.is_none(), SQLInterface: "`TRUNCATE ... CASCADE/RESTRICT` is not supported");
9029    polars_ensure!(on_cluster.is_none(), SQLInterface: "`TRUNCATE ... ON CLUSTER` is not supported");
9030    polars_ensure!(partitions.is_none(), SQLInterface: "TRUNCATE does not support use of 'partitions'");
9031    let [
9032        TruncateTableTarget {
9033            name,
9034            // no table inheritance: cosmetic
9035            only: _,
9036            has_asterisk: _,
9037        },
9038    ] = table_names.as_slice()
9039    else {
9040        polars_bail!(SQLInterface: "TRUNCATE expects exactly one table name; found {}", table_names.len())
9041    };
9042    Ok((name, *if_exists))
9043}
9044
9045/// The change an `ALTER TABLE` operation makes to a catalog table.
9046fn alter_table_operation(op: &AlterTableOperation) -> PolarsResult<CatalogAlter> {
9047    Ok(match op {
9048        AlterTableOperation::AddColumn {
9049            if_not_exists,
9050            column_def,
9051            column_position,
9052            ..
9053        } => {
9054            polars_ensure!(
9055                column_position.is_none(),
9056                SQLInterface: "`ADD COLUMN ... FIRST | AFTER` is not supported"
9057            );
9058            let (name, dtype) = alter_table_column(column_def)?;
9059            CatalogAlter::AddColumn {
9060                name,
9061                dtype,
9062                if_not_exists: *if_not_exists,
9063            }
9064        },
9065        AlterTableOperation::DropColumn {
9066            column_names,
9067            if_exists,
9068            drop_behavior,
9069            ..
9070        } => {
9071            polars_ensure!(
9072                !matches!(drop_behavior, Some(DropBehavior::Cascade)),
9073                SQLInterface: "`DROP COLUMN ... CASCADE` is not supported"
9074            );
9075            let [column] = column_names.as_slice() else {
9076                polars_bail!(SQLInterface: "`ALTER TABLE` takes one operation per statement")
9077            };
9078            CatalogAlter::DropColumn {
9079                name: column.value.clone(),
9080                if_exists: *if_exists,
9081            }
9082        },
9083        AlterTableOperation::RenameColumn {
9084            old_column_name,
9085            new_column_name,
9086        } => CatalogAlter::RenameColumn {
9087            old: old_column_name.value.clone(),
9088            new: new_column_name.value.clone(),
9089        },
9090        AlterTableOperation::AlterColumn { column_name, op } => {
9091            let name = column_name.value.clone();
9092            match op {
9093                AlterColumnOperation::SetDataType {
9094                    data_type, using, ..
9095                } => {
9096                    polars_ensure!(
9097                        using.is_none(),
9098                        SQLInterface: "`ALTER COLUMN ... TYPE ... USING` is not supported"
9099                    );
9100                    CatalogAlter::SetDataType {
9101                        name,
9102                        dtype: map_sql_dtype_to_polars(data_type)?,
9103                    }
9104                },
9105                AlterColumnOperation::DropNotNull => CatalogAlter::DropNotNull { name },
9106                AlterColumnOperation::SetNotNull => polars_bail!(
9107                    SQLInterface: "`SET NOT NULL` is not supported: the rows of column '{}' may be null",
9108                    name
9109                ),
9110                _ => polars_bail!(
9111                    SQLInterface: "`ALTER COLUMN {} {}` is not supported for catalog tables", name, op
9112                ),
9113            }
9114        },
9115        AlterTableOperation::SetTblProperties { table_properties } => CatalogAlter::SetProperties {
9116            properties: alter_table_properties(table_properties)?,
9117        },
9118        _ => polars_bail!(
9119            SQLInterface: "`ALTER TABLE ... {}` is not supported for catalog tables", op
9120        ),
9121    })
9122}
9123
9124/// The query whose rows an `INSERT` writes, with the `WITH` of a query around it; `None` for
9125/// `DEFAULT VALUES`. Clauses a catalog table has no use for are refused.
9126fn insert_source(insert: &Insert, outer: Option<&Query>) -> PolarsResult<Option<Query>> {
9127    let statement = if insert.overwrite {
9128        "INSERT OVERWRITE"
9129    } else {
9130        "INSERT"
9131    };
9132    let refused = [
9133        (insert.or.is_some(), "`INSERT OR ...`"),
9134        (insert.ignore, "`INSERT IGNORE`"),
9135        (insert.replace_into, "`REPLACE INTO`"),
9136        (insert.on.is_some(), "`ON CONFLICT` / `ON DUPLICATE KEY`"),
9137        (insert.returning.is_some(), "`RETURNING`"),
9138        (insert.table_alias.is_some(), "a table alias"),
9139        (!insert.assignments.is_empty(), "`INSERT ... SET`"),
9140    ];
9141    for (found, clause) in refused {
9142        polars_ensure!(!found, SQLInterface: "{} is not supported for catalog tables", clause);
9143    }
9144    if insert.partitioned.is_some() {
9145        let hint = match insert.overwrite {
9146            true => {
9147                "; `sink_iceberg(..., partition_overwrite=\"dynamic\")` replaces only the partitions written"
9148            },
9149            false => "",
9150        };
9151        polars_bail!(SQLInterface: "`{} ... PARTITION (...)` is not supported for catalog tables{}", statement, hint);
9152    }
9153    polars_ensure!(
9154        insert.after_columns.is_empty()
9155            && insert.output.is_none()
9156            && insert.priority.is_none()
9157            && insert.insert_alias.is_none()
9158            && insert.settings.is_none()
9159            && insert.format_clause.is_none()
9160            && insert.multi_table_insert_type.is_none()
9161            && insert.multi_table_into_clauses.is_empty()
9162            && insert.multi_table_when_clauses.is_empty()
9163            && insert.multi_table_else_clause.is_none(),
9164        SQLInterface: "unsupported {} statement: `{}`", statement, insert
9165    );
9166    let Some(source) = &insert.source else {
9167        return Ok(None);
9168    };
9169    polars_ensure!(
9170        !matches!(source.body.as_ref(), SetExpr::Table(_)),
9171        SQLInterface: "`{} ... TABLE <name>` is not supported; write `SELECT * FROM <name>`", statement
9172    );
9173    polars_ensure!(
9174        !matches!(
9175            source.body.as_ref(),
9176            SetExpr::Insert(_) | SetExpr::Update(_) | SetExpr::Delete(_) | SetExpr::Merge(_)
9177        ),
9178        SQLInterface: "the query of {} must not change a table", statement
9179    );
9180    let mut source = (**source).clone();
9181    if let Some(outer) = outer {
9182        polars_ensure!(
9183            outer.order_by.is_none()
9184                && outer.limit_clause.is_none()
9185                && outer.fetch.is_none()
9186                && outer.locks.is_empty(),
9187            SQLInterface: "unsupported {} statement: `{}`", statement, outer
9188        );
9189        if let Some(with) = &outer.with {
9190            polars_ensure!(
9191                source.with.is_none(),
9192                SQLInterface: "{} takes one WITH: before the statement or in its query", statement
9193            );
9194            source.with = Some(with.clone());
9195        }
9196    }
9197    Ok(Some(source))
9198}
9199
9200fn parse_single_statement(query: &str) -> PolarsResult<Statement> {
9201    let ast = parse_sql(query)?;
9202    polars_ensure!(ast.len() == 1, SQLInterface: "one (and only one) statement can be parsed at a time");
9203    Ok(ast.into_iter().next().unwrap())
9204}
9205
9206fn parse_sql(query: &str) -> PolarsResult<Vec<Statement>> {
9207    sql_parser(query)?
9208        .parse_statements()
9209        .map_err(to_sql_interface_err)
9210}
9211
9212bitflags::bitflags! {
9213    /// Bitfield indicating whether there exists a projection with the specified height behavior.
9214    ///
9215    /// Used to help determine whether to execute projections in `select()` or `with_columns()`
9216    /// context.
9217    #[derive(PartialEq)]
9218    struct ExprSqlProjectionHeightBehavior: u8 {
9219        /// Maintains the height of input column(s)
9220        const MaintainsColumn = 1 << 0;
9221        /// Height is independent of input, e.g.:
9222        /// * expressions that change length: e.g. slice, explode, filter, gather etc.
9223        /// * aggregations: count(*), first(), sum() etc.
9224        const Independent = 1 << 1;
9225        /// "Inherits" the height of the context, e.g.:
9226        /// * Scalar literals
9227        const InheritsContext = 1 << 2;
9228    }
9229}
9230
9231impl ExprSqlProjectionHeightBehavior {
9232    fn identify_from_expr(expr: &Expr) -> Self {
9233        let mut has_column = false;
9234        let mut has_independent = false;
9235
9236        for e in expr.into_iter() {
9237            use Expr::*;
9238            has_column |= matches!(e, Column(_) | Selector(_));
9239            has_independent |= match e {
9240                // @TODO: This is broken now with functions.
9241                AnonymousFunction { options, .. } => {
9242                    options.returns_scalar() || !options.is_length_preserving()
9243                },
9244                Literal(v) => !v.is_scalar(),
9245                Explode { .. } | Filter { .. } | Gather { .. } | Slice { .. } => true,
9246                Agg { .. } | Len => true,
9247                _ => false,
9248            }
9249        }
9250        if has_independent {
9251            Self::Independent
9252        } else if has_column {
9253            Self::MaintainsColumn
9254        } else {
9255            Self::InheritsContext
9256        }
9257    }
9258}
